releaseName: HDE Studio v2.2.7 — AutoCAD Dimensioning & Auto-Dimension
releaseNotes:
## What's New in v2.2.7

* **AutoCAD-style Dimension Tool**: Select two points with real-time rubber-band measurement and dynamic offset dragging.
* **1-Click Wall Auto-Dimensioning**: Hover over any wall to highlight and click once to immediately drag out full-length dimensions.
* **Interactive Dimension Grips**: Select existing dimensions to dynamically adjust offset distance or endpoint positions.
* **60 FPS Live Dragging & Crosshair Feedback**: Smooth real-time canvas updates while drafting dimensions.
* **14-Day Free Evaluation Trial**: Built-in 14-day evaluation trial for new users with machine fingerprint security.
* **Public Release Distribution Channel**: Separated release binaries from private source repository.

### Downloads
* Windows Installer: HDE-Studio-Setup-v2.2.7.exe
* Standalone Java Application: HDE-Studio.jar
